subtitle: A store for app repositories
description:
The store you're looking at. It lists every app in a repository of Holm apps, gives each one its own page with screenshots, ratings and reviews, and the prompt that built it, and installs it on your node from a Get button. A Get started guide shows newcomers how to set up a node of their own.

Sign in to review an app; reviews appear once an admin approves them. The node's owner and admins get an admin page to show or hide apps, see how often each is viewed and installed, approve reviews and pick the store's colour, and Holm's analytics from the avatar menu.

It reads the repository's index.json, the same file holm app install uses to pick and check a release. Point it at your own repository to give your apps a store of their own.
whatsNew: The cover is now a carousel of the featured apps, and below it you can search the store as you type and switch between a list and a grid of square tiles. A search lives in the address, so you can share it. The Get started guide is lighter too, with an illustration you can play with.

screenshots.alt: The front page: the featured apps' covers in a carousel, above every app
All apps as a grid in dark mode: square tiles with each app's icon, category and a Get button, under search and the list or grid switch
The Get started guide: one prompt to copy, beside the store's apps riding a belt into your node
An app's page in dark mode: icon, rating, facts and screenshots
Ratings and reviews on an app's page, with a button to write one
The install sheet: a prompt for your coding agent, written for your node
The admin page: apps with their numbers and a switch to show or hide each one
